hanziSentence: 我们需要了解更多的细节。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men xū yào liǎo jiě gèng duō de xì jié.
meaningSentence: We need to know more details.

hanziSentence: 我们可以改变工作的方式。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men kě yǐ gǎi biàn gōng zuò de fāng shì.
meaningSentence: We can change the working method.

hanziSentence: 这批货物通过海运发送。
pinyinSentence: zhè pī huò wù tōng guò hǎi yùn fā sòng.
meaningSentence: This batch of goods is sent by sea freight.

hanziSentence: 重要的文件通过空运送达。
pinyinSentence: zhòng yào de wén jiàn tōng guò kōng yùn sòng dá.
meaningSentence: Important documents are delivered by air freight.

hanziSentence: 我们需要更多的时间来完成这个项目。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men xū yào gèng duō de shí jiān lái wán chéng zhè ge xiàng mù.
meaningSentence: We need more time to complete this project.

hanziSentence: 你的要求已经被接受了。
pinyinSentence: nǐ de yāo qiú yǐ jīng bèi jiē shòu le.

hanziSentence: 我们已经安排好了会议时间。
pinyinSentence: wǒ men yǐ jīng ān pái hǎo le huì yì shí jiān.
meaningSentence: We have already arranged the meeting time.

hanziSentence: 这家店的产品非常便宜。
pinyinSentence: zhè jiā diàn de chǎn pǐn fēi cháng pián yí.
meaningSentence: The products in this store are very cheap.
